<p style="margin: 0px 0pt; text-align: left; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: right; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; text-align: left; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;"><font style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;"><br>
<b>Usio Reports Strong&nbsp;Third Quarter&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667217498304">2026</a>&nbsp;Results; Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup> Increases&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="16" id="led128747F20261051793910478616">222%</a></b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">GAAP Net Income Increases by over $632,000 Year-Over-Year to $217,000, or $0.01 Per Share</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">Revenue Increases&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20264111778502586684">12%</a>; Gross Profit Increases&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x4" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20261051793910522296">18%</a>;&nbsp;Adjusted EBITDA&nbsp;Margin<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup> Expands&nbsp;to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="18x2" data-tblname="128745" data-tblv="16" id="led128745F20261051793910558900">5.0%</a></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 12pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: center; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;"><a data-tblloc="48x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261061793969723976">Nine</a>-Month Operating Cash Flow Increases <a data-tblloc="2x3" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20261051793910881370">133%</a> to <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20261051793910862032">$3.3</a> Million</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:12pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 14pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">SAN ANTONIO, November 10, <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;(GLOBE NEWSWIRE) &#8211; Usio, Inc., "Usio" or the "Company"&nbsp;(Nasdaq: USIO), a leading FinTech company&nbsp;that operates a full stack of integrated, cloud-based electronic payment and embedded financial solutions, today announced financial results for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a>&nbsp;quarter&nbsp;ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218799775">September 30, 2026</a>.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Louis Hoch, President and Chief Executive Officer of Usio, said,&nbsp;&#8220;It was another strong quarter for Usio, with revenue increasing <a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20261051793910774354">12%</a> and Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup> rising <a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="16" id="led128747F20261051793910764983">222%</a>, driven by sustained transaction growth and improving operating leverage. Total payment dollars processed increased <a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F2024771723062368254">25%</a> to <a data-tblloc="10x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F2024771723062386146">$2.73</a> billion, while total payment transactions grew 27% to 20.7 million. ACH transactions increased <a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686181716">39%</a>, setting a new quarterly record for the sixth consecutive quarter. Importantly, this growth is translating into meaningful bottom-line improvement. Adjusted EBITDA&nbsp;margin<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup> expanded to <a data-tblloc="18x2" data-tblname="128745" data-tblv="16" id="led128745F20261051793910558900">5.0%</a> from <a data-tblloc="18x4" data-tblname="128745" data-tblv="16" id="led128745F20261051793910808231">1.7%</a> a year ago, GAAP operating income improved by approximately $743,000, and we delivered our third consecutive quarter of positive GAAP net income. For the first&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="49x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261061793969739116">nine</a> months of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup> more than doubled, while operating cash flow increased <a data-tblloc="2x3" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20261051793910881370">133%</a> to <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20261051793910862032">$3.3</a> million. Consequently, we are re-iterating our guidance of 14-16% revenue growth versus the prior year, alongside record Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>.&#8221;</p>

<p style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; margin: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Mr. Hoch continued, &#8220;Looking ahead, we are particularly encouraged by the opportunities presented by Usio Ion and our recently announced strategic partnership with Harris Computer. Ion has the potential to deepen our existing customer relationships, expand our third-party owned deposit base and generate incremental high-margin interest revenue, while our preferred payments provider relationship with Harris expands our reach into the utility market. We believe both initiatives can contribute meaningfully to our long-term growth and operating leverage as adoption and implementation progress. It is exciting to soon enter 2027 with these two catalysts on top of the organic growth we are already experiencing.&#8221;</p>

<p style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; margin: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Results in the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a> quarter were led by an&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="16" id="led64716F20264111778499944735">18%</a> increase in credit card revenues on the strength of a 29% increase in PayFac revenues, which now account for more than 75% of total credit card revenues.&nbsp;ACH, our highest margin business, had another record quarter. Revenues were up <a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="16" id="led64716F20264111778500247721">9%</a> primarily due to record ACH transaction volume, which was up <a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686181716">39%</a>, alongside record RTP volume and continued strong PINless debit growth. ACH has benefitted from new account growth and strong volumes in the education market. Output Solutions had an outstanding quarter with&nbsp;revenue growing <a data-tblloc="5x4" data-tblname="64716" data-tblv="16" id="led64716F20264111778500317494">14%</a>. Volumes were at record levels with electronic documents processed and delivered up 28% and total pieces printed and mailed&nbsp;up 7%.&nbsp;In addition, <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a> quarter prepaid card services revenues were up from a year ago, the first quarterly increase this year.&nbsp;Prepaid card services also experienced increased volumes, providing further momentum to the recovery in revenues.</p>

<p style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; margin: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Reflective of the Company&#8217;s increasing operating leverage, gross profit was&nbsp;up approximately&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x4" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20269291793274321631">18%</a> to $5.7 million in the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a>&nbsp;quarter, with gross margins expanding to&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20261061793969037986">24.1%</a> from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20261061793969045782">23.0%</a> in the prior-year quarter. <a data-tblloc="44x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261091794234422458">Third</a>&nbsp;quarter total selling, general and administrative expenses,&nbsp;inclusive of depreciation and amortization and stock-based compensation ("Total SG&amp;A Expenses"),&nbsp;increased only approximately 2% year-over-year, while declining for the first <a data-tblloc="49x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261061793969739116">nine</a> months of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> compared to the prior-year period. This disciplined expense management was achieved while continuing to invest in back-office operations and network infrastructure to support sustainable growth.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">For the quarter ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218799775">September 30, 2026</a>, the Company reported GAAP net income of approximately&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20261051793911149934">$0.2</a> million, or&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="14x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20261051793911157247">$0.01</a> per share, compared to a net loss of (<a data-tblloc="13x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20261051793911166410">$0.4</a>) million, or (<a data-tblloc="14x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20261051793911171559">$0.02</a>) per share, for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261061793969143867">2025</a>. Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="16" id="led128747F20261051793911188886">$1.2</a> million for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="128747" data-tblv="16" id="led128747F20261051793911197144">222%</a>&nbsp;from the same quarter a year ago. Operating cash flow more than doubled to approximately&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20261051793911207480">$3.3</a> million for the first <a data-tblloc="49x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261061793969739116">nine</a> months of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, an increase of <a data-tblloc="2x3" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20261051793911220346">133%</a>, despite the prior-year period benefiting from nearly $1.5 million in one-time&nbsp;employee retention tax credit collections that were&nbsp;not present in the current year period.&nbsp;Cash was in excess of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64712" data-tblv="16" id="led64712F20261061793969200133">$7.3</a>&nbsp;million at&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218799775">September 30, 2026</a>, an increase of approximately&nbsp;$900,000 over the past three months.&nbsp;The Company used approximately $499,000 to repurchase 327,000 shares of its common stock during the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="49x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261061793969739116">nine</a> months ended <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218799775">September 30, 2026</a>.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; margin: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><b><u>Quarterly Processing and Transaction Volumes</u></b></p>

<p style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; margin: 0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Total payment dollars processed through all payment channels in the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="10x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F2024771723062386146">$2.73</a> billion, an increase of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="12x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F2024771723062368254">25%</a> over the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="10x2" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F2024771723062396886">$2.18</a> billion processed in last year's <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter.&nbsp;Total payment transactions processed in the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>&nbsp;were 20.7 million, an increase&nbsp;of 27% over the same quarter of last year.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Our credit card segment continues to grow, where dollars processed in the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686143924">7%</a> and transactions processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="3x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686149539">17%</a> from the year ago quarter. In the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, ACH electronic check transaction volume was&nbsp;up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686181716">39%</a>, setting a new quarterly transaction volume record for the sixth consecutive quarter, while&nbsp;electronic check dollars processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="6x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686188862">26%</a> and return check transactions processed were up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686195815">44%</a>, in each case, compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2026441777896755185">2025</a>. In our&nbsp;prepaid card services business unit during the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>,&nbsp;card load volume was up <a data-tblloc="7x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20269291793274988827">6%</a>, and transactions processed were down&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="8x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686164394">2%</a>;&nbsp;however, purchase volume&nbsp;was up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="64715" data-tblv="16" id="led64715F20233281682686172563">17%</a>&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, in each case, compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20259281761652517712">2025</a>.&nbsp;Output Solutions pieces processed and mailed were up 7% while electronic documents processed and delivered were up 28% for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, in each case, compared to the same quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20259281761652517712">2025</a>.</p>

<p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b><a data-tblloc="43x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261091794234535832">Three and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;Revenue Detail</b></u></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Revenues for the quarter ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667217678779">September 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20229311667217706070">$23.8</a>&nbsp;million, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x4" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20264111778499697479">12%</a> from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20251061762436943817">$21.2</a>&nbsp;million in the prior year quarter, due to increases in all of our business lines, as well as increased total interest revenues.&nbsp;Revenues for the <a data-tblloc="49x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261061793969739116">nine</a> months ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667217678779">September 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785326874475">$72.9</a>&nbsp;million, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x8" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785326881280">15%</a>&nbsp;from&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="2x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785326887936">$63.2</a>&nbsp;million in the prior year period, due&nbsp;to increases in all of our business lines, excluding prepaid card services, despite lower total interest revenues.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Gross profit&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20229311667217861249">$5.7</a>&nbsp;million, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x4" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2026761786025749388">18%</a> versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2026441777896860687">$4.9</a> million in the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686978409">2025</a>. Gross margins (defined as gross profit as a percentage of total revenues)&nbsp;were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20229311667217868890">24.1%</a>&nbsp;in&nbsp;the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, up versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2026441777896904375">23.0%</a>&nbsp;in the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20229311667218784763">third</a> quarter of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20251061762437050109">2025</a>. This was&nbsp;primarily due to&nbsp;revenue mix, as our higher margin business lines contributed proportionally more revenue in the quarter.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Gross profit&nbsp;for the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">nine months ended September 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785326946146">$16.6</a>&nbsp;million, up&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x8" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2026761786027130290">12%</a> versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="4x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785326951840">$14.8</a>&nbsp;million in the first <a data-tblloc="49x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261061793969739116">nine</a> months of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686978409">2025</a>. Gross margins were&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785326960848">22.8%</a>&nbsp;in&nbsp;the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20261091794234601478">nine months ended September 30, 2026</a>, down versus&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785326967118">23.5%</a>&nbsp;in the corresponding period&nbsp;of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20251061762437050109">2025</a>. This was&nbsp;primarily due to revenue mix and lower interest revenues, a high margin revenue source.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Total SG&amp;A Expenses for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> were $5.5 million, an increase of approximately 2% compared to $5.3 million in the prior-year quarter, primarily reflecting continued investments in back-office operations and network infrastructure. Notably, Total SG&amp;A Expenses grew significantly slower than revenue and gross profit, demonstrating the Company's increasing operating leverage.&nbsp;SG&amp;A expense for the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a> was up marginally from&nbsp;the corresponding prior year quarter, primarily due to increases in salary&nbsp;alongside&nbsp;increases in network infrastructure&nbsp;and&nbsp;professional fees.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Total SG&amp;A Expenses for the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">nine months ended September 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;were&nbsp;$15.7 million, down 1% versus the corresponding year ago period primarily due to lower depreciation&nbsp;and amortization expense offsetting slightly higher SG&amp;A expenses.&nbsp;SG&amp;A expenses for the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">nine months ended September 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;were up marginally from&nbsp;the corresponding prior year period, primarily due to increases in salary&nbsp;alongside&nbsp;increases in network infrastructure&nbsp;and&nbsp;professional fees.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">For the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, we reported&nbsp;operating income of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20236311690828878985">$0.3</a>&nbsp;million&nbsp;compared to an operating loss of (<a data-tblloc="9x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2024721722602768544">$0.5</a>) million for the same quarter a year ago, primarily due to increased revenues and gross profit, offsetting a nominal increase&nbsp;in Total SG&amp;A Expenses. Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="16x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20229311667217955432">$1.2</a>&nbsp;million for the <a data-tblloc="45x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F2024721722602131392">third</a> quarter of <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, compared to&nbsp;Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2024491715262601824">$0.4</a>&nbsp;million for the same quarter a year ago. Net income in&nbsp;the quarter ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20237101691688231954">September 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;was <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20236311690828900390">$0.2</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="14x1" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20229311667218004520">$0.01</a>&nbsp;per share, compared to a net loss of (<a data-tblloc="13x2" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F2024721722602807883">$0.4</a>) million, or (<a data-tblloc="14x2" data-tblname="128743" data-tblv="16" id="led128743F20229311667218064431">$0.02</a>) per share,&nbsp;for the same period in the prior year.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">For the&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">nine months ended September 30, 2026</a>, we reported&nbsp;operating income of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="9x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785327211728">$0.9</a>&nbsp;million&nbsp;compared to an operating loss of (<a data-tblloc="9x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785327217691">$1.1</a>) million for the same period&nbsp;a year ago, primarily due to increased revenues and gross profit, alongside a decrease in Total SG&amp;A Expenses. Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;was&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785327233690">$3.1</a>&nbsp;million for the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">nine months ended September 30, 2026</a>, compared to&nbsp;Adjusted EBITDA<sup style="vertical-align:top;line-height:120%;">1</sup>&nbsp;of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="17x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785327250525">$1.5</a>&nbsp;million for the same period a year ago. Net income in&nbsp;the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20266291785326935264">nine months ended September 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;was approximately <a data-tblloc="13x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785327261072">$0.6</a>&nbsp;million, or <a data-tblloc="14x5" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785327273416">$0.02</a>&nbsp;per share, compared to a net loss of (<a data-tblloc="13x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785327285705">$1.0</a>) million, or (<a data-tblloc="14x6" data-tblname="64711" data-tblv="16" id="led64711F20266291785327293970">$0.04</a>) per share,&nbsp;for the same period in the prior year.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt 9.35pt 0pt 0pt; text-align: justify;">Operating cash flow increased <a data-tblloc="2x3" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20261051793911220346">133%</a> to <a data-tblloc="2x1" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20229311667218268164">$3.3</a> million for the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20229311667218235799">nine months ended September 30, 2026</a>, compared to <a data-tblloc="2x2" data-tblname="64713" data-tblv="16" id="led64713F20229311667218356250">$1.4</a> million in the same period of <a data-tblloc="32x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20251061762437050109">2025</a>, supported by improved profitability. Notably,&nbsp;the prior-year period benefited from nearly $1.5 million in one-time employee retention tax credit collections&nbsp;that were not present in the current year period.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">We believe we continue&nbsp;to be in solid financial condition.&nbsp;Cash and cash equivalents as of&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20229311667218448700">September 30, 2026</a>&nbsp;were <a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64712" data-tblv="16" id="led64712F20229311667218437285">$7.3</a> million with minimal long-term debt. Cash this year has been used for capital expenditures, primarily Output Solutions equipment. In addition, approximately $499,000 in cash was used to repurchase 327,000 shares of our common stock during the <a data-tblloc="13x1" data-tblname="64488" data-tblv="16" id="led64488F20229311667218235799">nine months ended September 30, 2026</a>.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>Conference Call and Webcast</b></u></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Usio's management will host a conference call on Tuesday, November 10, <a data-tblloc="0x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20244141715686906983">2026</a>, at 4:30 pm Eastern time&nbsp;to review financial results and provide a business update.&nbsp;To listen to the conference call, interested parties within the&nbsp;U.S.&nbsp;should call +1-844-883-3890. International callers should call&nbsp;+&nbsp;1-412-317-9246. All callers should ask for the Usio conference call. The conference call will also be available through a live webcast, which can be accessed via the Company&#8217;s website at&nbsp;www.usio.com/investors.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

The replay can be accessed via the Company&#8217;s website or by dialing 1-855-669-9658 (U.S.) or&nbsp;1-412-317-0088&nbsp;(international). The replay conference playback code is 7548744.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>About Usio, Inc.</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Usio, Inc.&nbsp;(Nasdaq:&nbsp;USIO), a leading, cloud-based, integrated FinTech electronic payment solutions provider, offers a wide range of payment solutions to merchants, billers, banks, service bureaus, integrated software vendors and card issuers. The Company operates credit, debit/prepaid, and ACH payment processing platforms to deliver convenient, world-class payment solutions and services to clients through its unique payment facilitation platform as a service. The Company, through its Usio Output Solutions division, offers services relating to electronic bill presentment, document composition, document decomposition and printing and mailing services. The strength of the Company lies in its ability to provide tailored solutions for card issuance, payment acceptance, and bill payments as well as its unique technology in the card issuing sector.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Usio&nbsp;is headquartered in&nbsp;San Antonio, Texas, and has offices in&nbsp;Austin, Texas. Websites:&nbsp;www.usio.com, www.usioion.com and&nbsp;www.akimbocard.com.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Find us on LinkedIn, Facebook&#174; and X.</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>Comparisons</b></u></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Unless otherwise indicated, all comparisons and growth rates represent year-over-year comparisons, with the quarterly period of this year compared to the corresponding quarter of the prior year and the <a data-tblloc="49x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261091794234905894">nine</a>-month period ended&nbsp;<a data-tblloc="5x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261091794234930668">September 30, 2026</a> compared to the corresponding <a data-tblloc="49x1" data-tblname="64490" data-tblv="16" id="led64490F20261091794234912004">nine</a>-month period of the prior year.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><u><b>About Non-GAAP Financial Measures</b></u></p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">This press release&nbsp;includes the non-GAAP financial measures, as defined in Regulation G adopted by the Securities and Exchange Commission, of EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margin. The Company reports its financial results in compliance with GAAP, but believes that also discussing non-GAAP financial measures is useful to investors because it provides them with financial measures the Company uses in the management of its business.</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; width: 100%;">

		<tr>
			<td style="width: 29px; padding: 0px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="width: 1687px;">The Company defines EBITDA as net income (loss), before interest income, interest expense, taxes, depreciation and amortization of intangibles.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td style="width: 29px; padding: 0px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="width: 1687px;">The Company defines Adjusted EBITDA as EBITDA, as defined above, less other income, plus non-cash stock-based compensation and certain non-recurring items, such as costs related to acquisitions.</td>
		</tr>
		<tr>
			<td style="width: 29px; padding: 0px; text-align: center; vertical-align: top;">&#8226;</td>
			<td style="width: 1687px;">The Company defines Adjusted EBITDA margin as Adjusted EBITDA, as defined above, divided by total revenues.</td>
		</tr>

</table>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">Management believes presenting EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margin&nbsp;is helpful to investors in evaluating the Company's operating performance because non-cash costs and other items that management believes are not indicative of its results of operations are excluded.&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt;">EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margin&nbsp;should be considered in addition to, not as a substitute for, or superior to, financial measures calculated in accordance with GAAP.&nbsp;They are not&nbsp;measurements of our financial performance under GAAP and should not be considered as alternatives to revenue,&nbsp;net income, or cash provided by (used in) operating activities, or any other performance measures derived in accordance with GAAP and may not be comparable to other similarly titled measures of other businesses. EBITDA, Adjusted EBITDA, and Adjusted EBITDA margin&nbsp;have&nbsp;limitations as analytical tools and you should not consider these non-GAAP financial measures in isolation or as&nbsp;substitutes for analysis of our operating results as reported under GAAP.</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>
